summary: Denali Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a sale of its Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) to a large pharmaceutical company. The PRV was received upon FDA approval of AVLAYAHTM (tividenofusp alfa) for Hunter syndrome in March 2026. The sale closed on July 27, 2026, under an asset purchase agreement dated June 12, 2026. Gross proceeds to Denali were $195.0 million. No further terms, advisors, or structural details were disclosed. The transaction appears straightforward, with no regulatory clocks beyond the PRV transfer. The risk-arb angle is limited given the all-cash, one-time nature; watch for any contingent payment obligations or milestone rights if disclosed later.
